title: Draftboard / polished interface, broken outcome
subtitle: A broad, 18-domain filled example: visual finish does not purchase a functioning core journey.
purpose: Let a single project operator create and retrieve tasks reliably across a browser restart.
boundary: Local browser interface, task API, and persistence boundary; one operator journey only.
intent_status: Accepted for a bounded experiment within the fictional scenario; not an actual portfolio commitment.
genesis_rationale: This fictional repository was created by agents to isolate a consumer-facing capability. Its boundary is a hypothesis, not proof that a separate repository is necessary.
alternatives: Implement the capability in an existing owner
authority: Illustrative delegated mandate only. No actual device, repository, deployment, financial, or lifecycle authority is granted by this example.
non_goals: Wait for a central registry to become operational

semantic_reviews.assessment: The design may be coherent while the product is still a UI prototype.
semantic_reviews.support: The premises describe consistent cards, semantic colors, and identifiable actions.
semantic_reviews.countercase: Screenshots cannot show persistence, tenant authorization, error recovery, or keyboard completion.
semantic_reviews.discriminator: Create a task through the real UI, kill/restart relevant processes, and retrieve it through an independent reader.
semantic_reviews.confidence_basis: High confidence in the logical distinction; no confidence claim about any real application.

semantic_reviews.assessment: Do not add collaboration, analytics, or a second UI until the single-operator outcome is demonstrated.
semantic_reviews.support: The central promise already requires data persistence and a working control path.
semantic_reviews.countercase: A user might value an ephemeral board; that would require an explicit intent revision, not silently weakening persistence.
semantic_reviews.discriminator: Compare persistent and intentionally ephemeral variants against the accepted beneficiary need.
semantic_reviews.confidence_basis: Scenario-based recommendation; retain both hypotheses until evidence distinguishes them.

next_action: Wire and verify durable creation end to end before more visual refinement; repair the keyboard-blocking modal in parallel.
stop_condition: Do not promote while task creation loses data or the required journey is inaccessible by keyboard.

restart_packet.accepted_baseline: Use this fixture as an example only; establish a real pinned subject and assignment before operational work.
failed_hypotheses: A well-formed record is not proof the product behavior occurred.
restart_packet.next_reproduction: Translate the scenario into a bounded authorized real-product experiment, then replace fictional premises with collected observations.
restart_packet.budget_and_permissions: No product mutation or external actions authorized by this package. Carry forward the actual cumulative budget and permissions from the operating mandate.

lineage.description: A constructed teaching case, not a measurement of changes in the user portfolio.

provenance_notice: Fictional worked example. Every purported product outcome below is an authored premise. Result records remain PROPOSED and instrument qualifications are absent, so the real evidence reducer grants no acceptance credit.
